title: Pumpkin and Parmesan Fritters
subtitle: gnocchi-style dough fried in sage butter
description: Roasted pumpkin is mashed with parmesan and flour into a gnocchi-like dough, sliced into thick rounds and fried in butter with a sage stalk. Serve with sour cream or yoghurt.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 160°C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Place the diced pumpkin on the tray and bake for about 1 hour until soft without browning. Cool.
Mash the pumpkin and mix with the parmesan, flour, salt, pepper and nutmeg into a gnocchi-like dough, adding more flour if needed.
Shape the dough into a 5 cm wide log and slice into 1 to 2 cm thick fritters. If they are too sticky, flour them and shake off the excess.
Heat a non-stick pan with the butter, a little oil and the sage stalk and fry the fritters for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until golden. Remove the sage before it burns.
Serve with sour cream or yoghurt.
